title: SmartSubs Pro v2.9.5
notes: A big usability update. Drag the caption onto the real timeline frame in the Style preview to place it (with a 3x3 quick-align grid), search your fonts with a live box, and see an animated word-by-word preview for Sentence Karaoke. Template names are now a dropdown that finds the Text+ clips in your Media Pool. The progress bar no longer freezes during transcription: it moves and shows an estimated time left. Plus a cleaner menu and a more accurate preview size.
